description.mn: Al Haramain Amber Oud Gold Edition Extreme: Unisex хув үнэр (Parfum). Эхний ноот: бергамот, ногоон ноот; зүрхний ноот: амтат гуа, чихэрлэг ноот, хуш мод, хан боргоцой, хув; суурь ноот: мирра, модлог ноот, заар, ваниль.
description.en: Amber Oud Gold Edition Extreme Pure Perfume by Al Haramain Perfumes is a Amber Woody fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Amber Oud Gold Edition Extreme Pure Perfume was launched in 2022. Top notes are Bergamot and Green Notes; middle notes are Melon, Sweet Notes, Cedar, Pineapple and Amber; base notes are Myrrh, Woodsy Notes, Musk and Vanilla.
